evidence.excerpt: [2] Laser Processing Machine business Research and development expenses for the laser processing machine business amounted to 78 million yen

notes: Laser Processing Machine segment R&D expense, from the narrative paragraph that gives each segment's figure in the same sentence form -- not from the thousands-of-yen sales table higher up the same page, hence JPY_million. Registered after an independent review pointed out that the first pass left it out on the stated grounds that it was never disclosed, which was wrong: it sits beside the semiconductor-segment figure that was registered, and all_businesses with the towa_laser_segment scope is the same pairing already used for this segment's production, orders and backlog. The segment figures cross-foot exactly to the disclosed company total every year: 885 + 78 = 963 million yen, which also shows the medical-device segment's R&D is not separately disclosed and is not silently inside either number.
